text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, you there, the lovely lady with the glasses.
Care to keep me company if you're free~?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Certainly, I just reached a good stopping point,
so I would not mind... Nature-san.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oh boy, saw right through me, huh.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Well... it is a voice I am quite accustomed to hearing.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, true enough. So, what were you doing
that you just reached a stopping point on?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I was accompanying various people
up until a moment ago.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...And because of Rice, the horseshoe of the girl
with me got ruined—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. From what I can see, maintenance will render it
usable again. Please rest assured.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, this incident had clear and definite causes.
If we eliminate them methodically, the "misfortune"
you speak of will not recur.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno, Ikuno!
Turbo wants to drink that over there!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Let us stop by, then. However, since we purchased
a large quantity of sweets today, let us stick to regular size.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Okaaay!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
A wind blows here that cannot be felt anywhere else...
This truly is a wondrous place.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...I had no idea such a place existed
so close to the academy...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it is my personally recommended wind spot.
However, whenever I take a stroll with others,
they always get separated along the way—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
You are the only one who has managed to keep up
with me all the way to the end, Ikuno-san.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
When it is just the two of us,
I never take my eyes off you, Zephyr-san.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see.
Always looking after everyone as usual~

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Being relied upon brings me great satisfaction.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Moving forward, I wish to broaden my knowledge
and perspectives so that I may be of even greater help.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, I’d love to say, "You're getting more
and more dependable!" but...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
That feels both right and
somehow slightly off.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Knowledge and logic might play a part, sure, but—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Everyone simply likes you because you take them
seriously and treat them with sincerity, Ikuno.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: They... like me...?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
In that case... I also like everyone,
as you all provide me with such diverse experiences.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Heheh, glad to hear it.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Changing the subject—Nature-san,
did you come here for a specific reason?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right, exactly! I was wondering
if you'd accompany me on a practice run.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I would be glad to.
I cannot turn down a request from someone who likes me.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Geesh.
That's exactly what I'm talking about, Ikuno-san.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Great form! Maintain that acceleration
and prepare to surge past from behind...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Got it!!

Nice Nature ran while taking in Ikuno Dictus's advice.
Their matched run was insightful even to anyone
watching from the sidelines.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Not yet! I will accompany you
as many times as it takes...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Though I say that—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Both of us are completely wiped out, huh~

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
My apologies. In my eagerness to meet
your expectations, Nature-san, I got carried away...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Caring for others is important... but one must
never forget proper pace management.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
True that~ ...But thanks. It made me really happy
seeing how dedicated you were.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.
